text:
Which statement about radioactive decay by α, β and γ emission is correct?
A
The only type of radioactive decay that changes a nucleus of one element to that of another
element is α-decay.
B
The only types of radioactive decay that change a nucleus of one element to that of another
element are α-decay and β-decay.
C
The only types of radioactive decay that change a nucleus of one element to that of another
element are α-decay and γ-emission.
D
The only types of radioactive decay that change a nucleus of one element to that of another
element are β-decay and γ-emission.
